name: Glyphic Memorandum
summary: In Anvilmar, Mountaineer Sten Stoutarm gives you a memorandum from mage trainer Marryk Nurribit, who invites you to meet him.

sections.title: A Missive for Novice Mages
sections.body: The summons is for you, a novice mage Sten assists in Coldridge Valley. Read it, then go inside Anvilmar to meet the gnome who wrote it. Your spellcraft studies begin there.

sections.title: Training with Marryk Nurribit
sections.body: Inside Anvilmar, gnome mage trainer Marryk Nurribit offers plain advice before your lessons. Keep out of serious trouble and save coin for training and tavern drinks. Stay clear of fallen Gnomeregan and its radioactive danger. Marryk is ready to teach you the arcane arts.

faq.answer: After you help mountaineer Sten Stoutarm with his early duties in Coldridge Valley, he gives you the memorandum.
Marryk Nurribit is a gnome mage trainer inside Anvilmar in Coldridge Valley. He teaches new mages their early spells and how to practice the arcane arts safely.

faq.q: Where can I find Marryk Nurribit?
aliases: where is the mage trainer in coldridge valley
faq.answer: You can find Marryk Nurribit inside Anvilmar's main hall, at the top of Coldridge Valley in Dun Morogh.

faq.q: Why does Marryk warn against visiting Gnomeregan?
faq.answer: Troggs overran Gnomeregan, and a catastrophic release of radioactive gas contaminated the city. It is perilous for a novice wandering Dun Morogh.
New mages beginning their studies in Coldridge Valley receive the memorandum to meet their class trainer.

faq.q: What does Marryk expect from his students?
faq.answer: Marryk advises his students to stay out of trouble, save silver for spell training and an ale for him, and keep away from Gnomeregan.

angles.text: As a mage, you meet your first arcane trainer in Dun Morogh through this memorandum.
As a gnome, you can learn from Marryk Nurribit, one of the gnome specialists who took refuge in dwarven lands after Gnomeregan fell.
As an Alliance member, you see dwarves and gnomes working together through Sten Stoutarm and Marryk Nurribit in Coldridge Valley.
